</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 588 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 245 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Steel Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=3)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This [steel shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=3) (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) is forged into the shape of a roaring lion’s head. The lion’s head functions as _+1 striking [shield boss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=41)_ that can’t be removed from the shield.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Raise a Shield;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You animate the lion’s head. You [Raise the Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98) and make a melee Strike with it as part of the same action. The shield’s biting maw is a martial melee weapon that deals 2d6 piercing damage and has the deadly 1d6 trait; it can’t be enhanced by runes. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, during which time you can Strike with it each time you Raise the Shield, as well as with a Strike action.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
